'''Kamen Proy''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who served in the ranks of the [[House Ulgo]]. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], he informed the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] about the [[U-20 Kingstrike]].
